task.title: Apple Watch Workout V1 Phase 1A physical Watch install and launch

result.summary: The Build 81 development candidate is installed and launches on the paired physical Founder Watch. Physical launch exposed a WatchConnectivity callback actor-isolation trap; it was symbolicated, fixed at 831f74d0, covered by off-main tests, rebuilt, re-signed, reinstalled and proven stable with no new crash log. The Watch shows the phone-reachable Prepare a workout on iPhone state. Health authorization and workout start remain an explicit Founder tap gate.

validation.origin_authority: implementation branch and remote both 831f74d0482906e34b5fcbb306cff3a4e7af2742; origin/main still identifies Build 81 as latest VALID shipping Native
validation.watch_unit_tests: 4/4 passed, including reply/failure callbacks invoked from Task.detached
validation.physical_release_build: passed for arm64 and arm64_32 with Watch-authorized automatic signing profile
validation.pairing: physical Watch connected, paired, booted and Developer Mode enabled
validation.watch_connectivity: phone-reachable Prepare a workout on iPhone state after automatic interactive refresh
validation.runtime: Watch process remained alive on delayed readback; no post-fix crash report
validation.duplicate_authority: no Ready-for-Watch draft, structured start, Health authorization, HealthKit workout or performed Training write occurred
